nativeUiSettingsView.isModDisabledHeader: This mod is disabled now. Please check the mod's CET window and the mod's log for more details.

openModMenu.title: Open Hotscenes menu
openModMenu.tooltips: Click to exit Settings menu and open the Hotscenes menu.

extendHotscenes.title: Longer hotscenes playback
extendHotscenes.tooltips: This option extends playback time and adds more variety to hotscenes.

sortByDisplayName.title: Sort performers by custom/translated names
sortByDisplayName.tooltips:
Sort performer lists preferring custom or translated names if available.
Please note that results may not be accurate in non-Latin languages.

hideNpcSpecs.title: Take off glasses.
hideNpcSpecs.tooltips:
When this option is enabled, engaged performers will take off glasses too.
This applies to the main menu scenes and the Night City Delights scenes (if Add-on is installed).

hideNpcFishnetTights.title: Take off fishnet tights
hideNpcFishnetTights.tooltips:
When this option is enabled, engaged performers will take off fishnet tights too.
This applies to the main menu scenes and the Night City Delights scenes (if Add-on is installed).

hideNpcSpikedChokers.title: Take off spiked chokers
hideNpcSpikedChokers.tooltips:
When this option is enabled, engaged performers will take off spiked chokers too.
This applies to the main menu scenes and the Night City Delights scenes (if Add-on is installed).

spycamOrbitPitchWithMouse.title: Spycam orbit mode uses mouse for vertical control
spycamOrbitPitchWithMouse.tooltips:
In the Spycam orbit mode:
-If enabled: use mouse up/down to control the spycam vertical position,
 use keyboard for forward/backward movement.
-If disabled: use keyboard forward/backward to control the spycam vertical position,
 use mouse up/down for forward/backward movement.

enableSpycamFreezeFrameToggleMode.title: Spycam Freeze Frame button is a toggle
enableSpycamFreezeFrameToggleMode.tooltips:
With this option enabled, the left mouse button toggles the Freeze Frame on and off.
If the option is disabled, the left mouse button freezes time only while pressed.
Note: for safety reasons, the Freeze Frame will automatically toggle back
in 60 seconds if you forget to switch it off.

enableHotscenesButtonInHubMenu.title: Enable Hotscenes Button in Hub Menu.
enableHotscenesButtonInHubMenu.tooltips:
This option adds the Hotscenes button to the game's Hub menu, allowing you to open the Hotscenes main menu window.
If disabled, the Hotscenes menu is still accessible either through the CET overlay or via a keyboard shortcut, if defined in the CET Bindings window.

enableNativeSettingsIntegration.title: Enable Native Settings integration.
enableNativeSettingsIntegration.tooltips: This option allows to open the mod's settings page in the Native Settings UI right from the mod Hotscenes Native UI menu.

nativeUiSettingsView.hotscenesAddOnNotDetected: Hotscenes Add-on is not detected. Extra features are not avaliable.
nativeUiSettingsView.hotscenesUnsupportedAddOnDetected: Unsupported Hotscenes Add-on is detected. Extra features are not avaliable. Please update the add-on.

enableHotscenesAddon.title: Enable Hotscenes Add-on
enableHotscenesAddon.tooltips:
Enables extra features provided by Hotscenes Add-on.
Please note that the final feature set may vary depending on game versions
and other mods that may affect the add-on.

enableSceneAvaliabilityOverride.title: Enable Hotscenes availability override
enableSceneAvaliabilityOverride.tooltips:
This feature allows playing scenes that the game has not yet made available.
Note: this feature will try to load the last game save upon scene playback completion
to revert changes that could negatively affect your playthrough.

enablePerformerPreviewSupport.title: Enable Performer Preview
enablePerformerPreviewSupport.tooltips:
This option enables the Performer Preview feature in the Native UI menu.

Please note that this feature requires the Add-on to be activated.

noGameReloads.title: Prefer no game reloads.
noGameReloads.tooltips:
This option speeds up main menu scene startups and completions by skipping game reloads if the add-on is activated.
Please note that a recovery manual save will still be created.

enableSceneAvaliabilityOverrideNotSuppor.title: Hotscenes availability override (Disabled)
enableSceneAvaliabilityOverrideNotSuppor.tooltips: The currently installed add-on version does not support scenes availability overrides. Please update the add-on plugin.

enable_mq055_integration.title: Enable Hangouts quests integration
enable_mq055_integration.tooltips:
This feature allows to integrate hotscenes playback with the game Hangouts quest scenes.
Note: this feature will try to load the last game save upon scene playback completion
to revert changes that could negatively affect your playthrough.

mq055_integration_prefer_vanilla_appeara.title: Prefer vanilla partner appearances in Hangouts
mq055_integration_prefer_vanilla_appeara.tooltips:
If this option is enabled, the mod will try to use vanilla appearances
for your partner if available, instead of Hotscenes exclusive appearances.
This option is designed to allow other mods change your partner's appearance.

enableNCDelightsFeature.title: Enable Night City Delights add-on
enableNCDelightsFeature.tooltips: Enables Night City Delights scenes provided by the add-on.

enableNCDelightsDynamicMappins.title: Night City Delights: reveal nearby performers
enableNCDelightsDynamicMappins.tooltips: When this option is enabled, nearby active performers will be indicated with markers.

enableNcSceneExtensions.title: Night City Delights: enable scene extensions
enableNcSceneExtensions.tooltips: This option enables additional scene extensions if avaliable.

restoreNpcDefaults.title: Night City Delights: restore NPC defaults
restoreNpcDefaults.tooltips:
This option aims to restore NPCs handled by this feature if their internal data is found affected or corrupted, possibly by other mods.

For the best results, please reload your game after enabling it.

Please note that enabling this option may prevent other mods from modifying these NPCs.

hotscenesUnavailable.header: Hotscenes not available at the moment.
hotscenesUnavailable.isCensored: The game is set to censored mode.

playback.timeout: Hotscene playback could not be started.
